Perfect Order Booster Bundles fell 20.5% this week, from $37.76 to $30.01 TCGplayer market.

That's the biggest weekly drop of any sealed product we track, and it now sits just 7 cents above its $29.94 MSRP. #PokemonTCG

Phantom Forces' Dialga EX secret rare (122/119) is one of the hardest Pokemon cards to grade.

3,332 graded by PSA. Only 55 tens: a 1.7% gem rate. Eight times as many land at PSA 9 (441).

Raw: $1,053.88 #PokemonTCG

A year ago, an OP-11 A Fist of Divine Speed booster box was $139.10 TCGplayer market, close to its $120 MSRP.

Today it's $529.10: up 280% in 12 months, the biggest 1-year gain of any One Piece box we track. #OnePieceTCG

OP-13 booster boxes are $389.30 today, down from a $609.55 peak in May.

Hot take: OP-13 looks even better at this price. The set hasn't changed, and it still holds iconic cards people will want to chase for years to come. #OnePieceTCG

12 months of two Sword & Shield booster boxes:

Evolving Skies: $2,548.74 → $2,194.68 (-13.9%)
Brilliant Stars: $417.22 → $561.84 (+34.7%)

Which would you rather hold for the next 5 years? #PokemonTCG
